name: Kettle & Crema

interaction.en: Pour your own latte art
interaction.zh: 亲手拉一杯拿铁拉花

brief: Quiet, airy specialty café. Palette: paper #F8F5F0, oat #EFE9E1, espresso #2B1D14, roast #6F4B34, matcha #7C8C5A used sparingly. Fonts: Shippori Mincho (display) + Figtree (UI). LAYOUT: desktop split screen — left 40% is a fixed panel (brand word mark, 'Open now / Opens 7am' computed from the visitor's clock against hours Mon–Fri 7:00–15:00, Sat–Sun 8:00–14:00, and the latte-art cup); right 60% scrolls: espresso & filter menu with dotted leaders and sample prices, tea, pastries, 'beans on rotation' origin cards, 'a slow bar' story, visit (Fitzroy). Phone: panel becomes the top section, then the menu. SIGNATURE: latte-art canvas — a cup seen from above with crema; press-and-drag (or hold Space and steer with arrow keys) to pour steamed milk: milk blobs spread, drift and get dragged by the pour path (particles/metaball-ish soft circles, crema edge darkening), so wiggles make a rosetta-like pattern; 'Reset cup' and a 'Show me a heart' auto-pour. Result text in DOM ('Nice pour — 72% milk'). Keep it elegant, lots of whitespace, thin rules, no heavy browns.

name: Golden Steamer

interaction.en: Stack your steamer baskets
interaction.zh: 点单即叠蒸笼

brief: Bilingual EN/中文 yum cha house, Chinese name 金笼 shown beside the English word mark (the data-brand element holds only 'Golden Steamer'). Palette: lacquer red #8E1B17, ink #1A1210, gold #C9A04A (decor only, not small text), rice paper #F6EFE3, jade #3F7A63. Fonts: Noto Serif SC + Outfit. HERO: a large bamboo steamer (CSS woven texture with repeating gradients) whose lid lifts on load revealing the name with rising steam wisps (SVG). MENU: categories as tabs — Steamed 蒸点, Fried 炸点, Rice rolls 肠粉, Sweets 甜点 — each dish a round steamer card: har gow 虾饺, siu mai 烧卖, char siu bao 叉烧包, cheung fun 肠粉, xiao long bao 小笼包, lo mai gai 糯米鸡, phoenix claws 凤爪, turnip cake 萝卜糕, egg tart 蛋挞, mango pancake 芒果班戟. SIGNATURE: 'Build your table' — adding a dish drops a steamer basket onto a growing stack on the right (bounce, stack height grows, dish initials on the rim), running total, 'Good for 4 people' suggestion, remove from stack; 'Send order' ends with a DemoKit toast. Also weekend queue tips, trolley hours, 'Sample prices'. Full EN ⇄ 中文 toggle (top right) switching all strings and html lang. Phone: the stack becomes a sticky bottom bar showing a mini stack + total.

name: Ember & Salt

interaction.en: Walk the 8-course menu, reserve a seat
interaction.zh: 逐道浏览八道菜并预订

brief: Wood-fired degustation. Palette: charcoal #121010, smoke #2A2522, ember #E4572E, ash #BDB3A8, bone #EFE7DC. Fonts: Cormorant Garamond (large italic display) + Hanken Grotesk (small-caps UI). LAYOUT: full-viewport scroll-snap 'courses' — an intro screen, then one screen per course I–VIII: huge thin roman numeral, dish name, three ingredient words, one sentence, wine pairing; behind each, a small canvas of rising embers/sparks (slow; stops off-screen; reduced motion = static warm glow). Right edge: course progress dots (buttons, keyboard, aria-current). After the courses: the room, the fire (story), dietary note, hours (Wed–Sat dinner). SIGNATURE: reservation side sheet — date strip for the next 14 days (open Wed–Sat only; others disabled with reason), party size 1–8 stepper, seating times 5:30/6:00/8:15/8:45 with a deterministic mix of 'Available' / 'Waitlist' states, dietary notes, summary card; confirm ends with 'Demo only — no reservation was made.' Phone: scroll-snap stays, sheet becomes full screen.

name: Lucky Lime Tacos

interaction.en: Follow the truck's weekly route
interaction.zh: 追踪餐车一周路线

brief: Loud, joyful taco truck. Palette: sunflower #FFD23F, black #111, hot pink #FF3E8A, sea green #3BCEAC, white. Neo-brutalism: 3px black borders, hard 6px offset shadows, 14px radius, sticker badges rotated a few degrees, tiles that 'press' on click. Fonts: Archivo Black + Space Grotesk. LAYOUT: a bento grid of different-size tiles — giant logo tile, 'Where's the truck today?' tile (map), menu tiles (birria tacos, Baja fish, elote cup, chipotle cauli, churros, horchata) that flip on click to show allergens, 'Cater your party' tile, 'Hours' tile, 'Sold out? Here's why' tile. SIGNATURE: weekly route map — a stylised SVG of Brisbane (a big river curve + suburb blobs: West End, Fortitude Valley, Paddington, New Farm, Woolloongabba, Newstead); Mon–Sun day buttons (today pre-selected from the visitor's weekday); choosing a day drives the truck icon along a path to that spot and shows address-free location name, time window and a tip. Keyboard + aria-pressed. Phone: tiles collapse 2 → 1 column; map tile full width.

name: Crumb & Co. Bakehouse

interaction.en: Oven-timer bake schedule & draggable recipe cards
interaction.zh: 烤箱计时出炉表与可拖动配方卡

brief: Everything looks drawn by hand. Palette: kraft #D8C3A0, paper #F7F0E1, brown ink #3B2A1A, tomato #D2553B, butter #F2C14E. Fonts: Caveat (headings, notes) + Lora (body). Wobbly SVG borders via an feTurbulence/feDisplacementMap filter, doodled loaves/croissants/scrolls as inline SVG line drawings, a coffee ring stain. LAYOUT: a kraft 'table top' with scattered, slightly rotated paper cards and notes: today's loaves, pastries, 'our slow ferment', Saturday pre-orders, visit. Desktop: cards are draggable (pointer events; keyboard: focus a card and move with arrow keys; 'Tidy up' button stacks them). Phone: cards stack neatly in reading order. SIGNATURE: 'Out of the oven' — a big analog oven timer dial with today's bake times (6:30 sourdough, 7:15 croissants, 8:00 cinnamon scrolls, 11:30 focaccia, 14:00 lemon tart); the hand points at the visitor's current time; tapping a slot shows what's fresh and 'about N left' (deterministic sample). Saturday pre-order form (loaf picker + pickup time) ends in a DemoKit toast.

name: Nonna's Wood Fire

style.zh: 意式小馆搪瓷招牌复古

interaction.en: Drag toppings onto your pizza
interaction.zh: 拖拽配料做披萨

brief: Family trattoria with a vintage enamel sign feel. Palette: enamel cream #F4ECD8, tomato #C8322B, basil #2E6B3F, charcoal #231F1C, gold stripe #D9A441; checkered tablecloth border, rounded enamel plaques with inner rim. Fonts: DM Serif Display + Work Sans. LAYOUT: centred circular pizza hero; menu printed as a paper placemat (Rosso / Bianco / Nonna's specials, sample prices); 'Nonna's rules' numbered list; wood-fire facts strip (450°C oven, 90-second bake); takeaway & hours. SIGNATURE: pizza builder — a round base (SVG); drag toppings (basil, mushroom, olive, salami, chilli, prosciutto, anchovy, rocket) from a tray and drop anywhere on the pizza (they scatter naturally as several pieces where dropped); 'Half & half' toggle splits the pizza so each half keeps its own toppings; size S/M/L scales it; price updates; keyboard/touch: every topping also has an 'Add' button. 'Into the oven' plays a short bake (cheese blisters, crust darkens) then a DemoKit toast. Phone: tray becomes a horizontal scroller under the pizza.

name: Kaiten Hana

interaction.en: Grab plates off the conveyor belt
interaction.zh: 从传送带上拿盘子

brief: Sushi train told like an emaki hand scroll. Palette: indigo #1F2F5C, washi #F3EEE3, vermilion #D9472B, soy #2B211C; plate colours for price tiers (green $4.5, blue $5.5, red $6.5, gold $7.5, black $9 — sample). Fonts: Zen Old Mincho + Inter. LAYOUT (desktop): panels flow horizontally from RIGHT to LEFT like a scroll; vertical mouse wheel moves the scroll; small vertical Japanese labels (writing-mode: vertical-rl) using only correct words like 寿司, 回転寿司, いらっしゃいませ. Panels: welcome, how the train works, plate colour guide, the conveyor, sake & green tea, visit. Phone: normal vertical flow, same content. SIGNATURE: an animated conveyor belt carrying plates with SVG sushi (salmon nigiri, tuna, tamago, inari, ebi, california roll, edamame, mochi); click/tap/Enter a plate to take it — it flies to 'your table' stack grouped by colour with a running total; belt pauses on hover/focus and when off-screen; 'Call staff' → DemoKit toast.

name: The Gilded Key

interaction.en: Knock to enter, find your cocktail
interaction.zh: 敲门入内，找到你的那杯

brief: Hidden laneway bar. Palette: black #0B0B0C, gold #C9A45C, emerald #0F3D32, cream #EDE3CF; SVG sunburst/fan patterns, stepped frames, thin gold double rules. Fonts: Limelight + Josefin Sans. LAYOUT: landing = a closed ornate double door filling the viewport with a brass knocker and the hint 'Knock three times'. Three clicks/taps/Enter presses swing the doors open (CSS 3D rotateY) into the bar: eight cocktails in deco frames, 'house rules', 'Thursday: live jazz', bookings for groups. Provide a visible 'Enter without knocking' link for accessibility and reduced motion. SIGNATURE 2: every cocktail has a flavour radar (SVG polygon: sweet, sour, bitter, boozy, fruity) that morphs smoothly when a drink is hovered/focused; 'Find my drink' sliders set your taste and the closest cocktail lights up with its radar overlaid on yours. Group booking form → DemoKit toast. Phone: door fits the screen; menu stacks.

name: The Signal Box Hotel

style.zh: 百年酒馆瓷砖与金箔招牌

interaction.en: Pull the perfect pint
interaction.zh: 亲手打一杯完美啤酒

brief: 1880s railway pub with bistro and rooms upstairs. Palette: bottle-green glazed tiles #1E4D3A (CSS tile pattern with glossy highlight), cream #F1E6CC, gold leaf #C79A3B (large text only, with dark outline), oxblood #6E1F1B, chalkboard #1F2421. Fonts: Playfair Display (small caps signwriting) + Libre Franklin. LAYOUT: a pub facade header band (tiles + gold lettering like a signwritten fascia); a chalkboard 'This week' board (Mon parma night, Tue schnitty, Wed trivia, Fri live music, Sun roast — sample prices); bistro menu; beer garden; four rooms upstairs; getting here from the station. SIGNATURE: 'Pull a pint' — six tap handles (lager, pale ale, amber, stout, cider, ginger beer); choose one, then press-and-hold the tap (or hold Space) to pour: the glass fills with liquid + rising bubbles + a foam head; release near the line for a 'perfect pour' rating; shows ABV & style note. Mini Wednesday-trivia teaser (3 playful questions about the pub's fictional history). Phone: taps in a horizontal row above the glass.

name: Two Hills Estate

interaction.en: Build a tasting flight
interaction.zh: 搭配你的品酒组合

brief: Family vineyard cellar door. Palette: parchment #F5EFE2, vine green #6B7F4B, shiraz #5B1A2E, dusk lilac #B7A7C9, soil #8A6A4F. Fonts: Fraunces (soft italic) + Figtree. LAYOUT: vertical scroll through layered rolling hills (SVG paths with watercolour-like gradients, soft edges, paper grain) that move at different speeds (subtle parallax, off for reduced motion); sections sit on 'terraces': our wines, the cellar door, grazing platters, events, visit. SIGNATURE: tasting flight builder — pick 4 of 8 wines (sparkling, rosé, fiano, chardonnay, grenache, shiraz, cabernet sauvignon, fortified); chosen wines appear as glasses on a paper tasting mat, filled with the right colour, automatically ordered light → heavy with one line explaining why; tasting notes appear on focus. Then book a tasting (date, time, group size 1–10) → DemoKit toast. Phone: mat becomes 2×2.

name: Scoop Scoop Gelato

interaction.en: Spin the flavour wheel
interaction.zh: 转盘决定口味

brief: Seaside gelato bar, pure fun. Palette: bubblegum #FF8FB1, mint #7FD8BE, butter #FFE066, lilac #C3A6FF, navy #22223B (text). Memphis shapes: squiggles, zigzags, dots, half circles as SVG, some drifting slowly. Fonts: Fredoka + DM Mono (prices). LAYOUT: playful centred composition; flavour grid shown as top-down tubs (circles with swirl textures) for today's 24 flavours with filters (Dairy-free, Vegan, Nut-free); cones & cups sizes; gelato cakes; find us near the pier. SIGNATURE: 'Can't decide? Spin the scoop wheel' — a large wheel of the currently filtered flavours; spins with eased physics and lands on one (Space/Enter to spin; aria-live announces the result); then a cone builder stacks up to 3 scoops with a wobble; 'Your cone' card lists them. Phone: wheel fits width, grid 2 columns.

name: Pearl Cloud

interaction.en: Customise a drink, watch the pearls drop
interaction.zh: 定制饮品，看珍珠落下

brief: Bubble tea brand (Chinese sub-name 云珠 shown as decoration; drink names carry small Chinese labels). Y2K kawaii: glossy lilac #C9B6FF, candy pink #FFB3D9, cloud white, chrome gradient type, sparkles, blobby 3D highlights, pill buttons; text purple #6A4C93 or darker for contrast. Fonts: Baloo 2 + Noto Sans SC. LAYOUT: desktop shows the site as a phone app centred on a dreamy background with floating clouds and stickers; on phones it IS the app (bottom tab bar: Menu · Build · Stores). SIGNATURE: drink customiser — tea base (jasmine green 茉莉绿茶, oolong 乌龙, black milk tea 奶茶, taro 芋头, brown sugar 黑糖), sugar 0/25/50/75/100%, ice none/less/regular, toppings (tapioca pearls, coconut jelly, pudding, red bean, cheese foam); a big cup visual updates live: liquid colour, ice cubes, pearls drop in with a bouncy physics settle, cheese foam layer; price updates; add to order → mini cart → 'Pick up at' time → DemoKit toast. Stores tab: two fictional locations with hours.

name: Hartley & Sons Butchers

interaction.en: Explore the cuts diagram
interaction.zh: 探索牛羊猪部位图

brief: Third-generation style butcher (fictional). Letterpress: cream #F2E8D5, oxblood #7A1F1F, ink #1C1A17; butcher-paper red/white stripes, ornamental rules and printer's fleurons, slightly uneven ink texture. Fonts: Alfa Slab One + IM Fell English. LAYOUT: a broadsheet price board 'This week's cuts' (sample prices per kg), then the interactive diagram, dry-ageing room, sausages made in-house (flavours list), BBQ packs, order for pickup. SIGNATURE: animal cuts diagrams — toggle Beef / Lamb / Pork; each is an SVG silhouette divided into primal cuts (chuck, rib, sirloin, rump, brisket, flank, shin; lamb shoulder/rack/loin/leg/shank; pork shoulder/belly/loin/leg); hover, tap or Tab to a cut: it highlights and a panel shows cut names, best methods (grill / roast / braise / slow cook), a cook's note and sample $/kg; 'Add to pickup list' builds a butcher-paper order slip with weights; submit → DemoKit toast. Phone: diagram full width; details below.

name: Cedar & Coal

style.zh: 街头炭烤风，英文⇄阿拉伯语 RTL

interaction.en: Feed-the-family calculator
interaction.zh: 全家分量计算器

brief: Late-night charcoal chicken shop. Palette: charcoal #1B1B1B, saffron #F2A007, garlic cream #FFF7E6, sumac #B8322A, cedar green #2F5D3A; subtle 8-point star lattice (geometric, non-religious) as an SVG pattern; flame motif. Fonts: Cairo (Arabic + Latin) + Archivo. LAYOUT: bold header with flame; menu boards — chicken (whole / half / quarter), charcoal plates, wraps, sides (chips, toum garlic sauce, tabouli, hummus, pickles, bread); 'Feed the family'; open late hours; catering. SIGNATURE 1: EN ⇄ العربية toggle that switches every visible string, sets html lang and dir, and mirrors the layout correctly using logical CSS (margin-inline, padding-inline, inset-inline, text-align:start). Arabic must be simple and correct, e.g. دجاج على الفحم، ثوم، تبولة، حمص، بطاطا مقلية، خبز، مخللات. SIGNATURE 2: 'Feed the family' — steppers for adults and kids build a suggested pack (whole chickens, large chips, toum, tabouli, bread) drawn as an animated table spread, with total price; 'Order ahead' → DemoKit toast. Mobile-first.

name: Salty's Fish Bar

interaction.en: Order ahead, print your ticket
interaction.zh: 提前点单，打印取餐单

brief: The site is the local newspaper your chips come wrapped in. Palette: newsprint #EDE7DA, ink #151515, lemon highlight #F4D03F, sea #2D6E8E; column rules, grainy newsprint, a greasy-paper translucent spot or two (subtle). Fonts: Old Standard TT (headlines) + Oswald (condensed heads). LAYOUT: newspaper front page — masthead with today's date, lead story 'Flathead is back' (catch of the day), multi-column body, menu as classifieds (flake, flathead, barramundi, calamari, potato scallops, chips by the scoop, minimum chips — sample prices), 'Tide & weather' box, 'Chippy notices' (hours, cash & card, beach tips). SIGNATURE: order ahead — tick items from the classifieds, choose a pickup slot (every 10 min, some marked 'busy'), and a paper ticket prints and slides out with the order and time; confirm → DemoKit toast. 'Catch of the day' cards flip to reveal species facts. Phone: single column that keeps column rules and newspaper typography.

name: Batch 47 Roasters

interaction.en: Morph the roast curve
interaction.zh: 拖动烘焙曲线

brief: Data-obsessed small-batch roaster with wholesale and a subscription. Palette: white #FAFAF7, graphite #1E1E1E, grid #E3E3DE, signal orange #FF5B1F, data green #1F9D55. Fonts: IBM Plex Mono + IBM Plex Sans. LAYOUT: spec-sheet pages on graph paper — each coffee as a spec table: 'Ethiopia — Guji', 'Colombia — Huila', 'Brazil — Cerrado', 'PNG — Western Highlands' (process, altitude, varietal, roast date, tasting notes, sample price per 250 g); brew recipes (pour-over, espresso, cold brew) as numbered procedures; wholesale for cafés; subscription frequency selector (weekly / fortnightly / monthly). SIGNATURE: roast profile chart — SVG line chart of bean temperature over time with first-crack marker and development-time band; a roast-level slider (light → dark) smoothly morphs the curve (path interpolation), shifts which notes light up on a flavour wheel (jasmine/citrus → caramel/cocoa → smoke), and updates a bean colour swatch. Phone: charts full width; tables become key–value lists.

name: Seoul Smoke

interaction.en: Cook on the grill — don't burn it
interaction.zh: 在烤盘上烤肉，别烤焦

brief: Late-night Korean BBQ. Palette: black #0A0A0F, magenta neon #FF2E88, cyan neon #25D9F2, amber #FFB000; brick wall pattern, wet-asphalt reflections under signs. Neon via layered text-shadow; one sign may gently buzz (no flashing; none in reduced motion). Korean words only when correct: 고기, 불고기, 삼겹살, 소주. Fonts: Black Han Sans + Space Grotesk. LAYOUT: a wall of neon sign panels (sets for 2/4/6, à la carte meats, sides & banchan, drinks, hours till late, group bookings). SIGNATURE: interactive grill — a round charcoal grill (canvas or SVG) with grate; tap meats on the tray (samgyeopsal, bulgogi, galbi, mushrooms, corn cheese) to place them; each item cooks over time (colour raw → golden → charred) with sizzle particles; tap to flip; take it off at the right time for 'Perfect!'; score counter; keyboard: tray buttons + list of items on grill with flip/take buttons. Group booking form → DemoKit toast. Phone: grill full width, tray horizontal.

name: Phở Sáu

interaction.en: Scrub the 12-hour broth
interaction.zh: 拖动看 12 小时熬汤

brief: Pho kitchen presented as a two-colour risograph zine. Palette: off-white #F5F1E8 + fluorescent pink #FF48B0 + teal #0078BF; overprints via mix-blend-mode: multiply, deliberate 2–3 px misregistration, grain (SVG noise), halftone illustrations (bowl, herbs, lime, chilli, star anise). Fonts: Be Vietnam Pro (correct Vietnamese diacritics) + Space Mono. LAYOUT: zine pages with page numbers and staples; menu with correct Vietnamese: phở bò tái, phở gà, bún bò Huế, gỏi cuốn, cà phê sữa đá, sample prices. SIGNATURE: '12-hour broth' scrubber — a horizontal timeline 0h → 12h; drag the knob (or arrow keys; it's a real range input underneath) to move through stages: bones blanched, onion & ginger charred, star anise/cinnamon/clove toasted, long simmer, skimming, seasoning with fish sauce and rock sugar; an illustrated pot deepens in colour, steam intensity changes, and a paragraph explains each stage. Phone: timeline full width, stage text below.

name: Green Wave Driving School

interaction.en: A car drives the page; pick a lesson slot
interaction.zh: 小车随滚动开过页面；选课时段

brief: Friendly bilingual EN/中文 driving school for nervous first-timers (Chinese name 绿波驾校 shown next to the word mark; data-brand holds the English name). Palette: cream #FFF9F0, mint #3DDC97, traffic green #1B9E5A, coral #FF6B57, asphalt #2F3437, lane-marking white. Do NOT use sky blue + yellow. Fonts: Plus Jakarta Sans + Noto Sans SC. LAYOUT: the page is a winding road (SVG path) running down the page; sections are stops along it: Start (hero: 'Nervous about driving? Start on green.' / '第一次上路，从绿灯开始'), Packages (single lesson, 5-pack, 10-pack, test package — sample prices), Test routes (Burwood, Silverwater, Ryde as stops), Instructors (illustrated avatars; languages English/Mandarin/Cantonese; fictional), FAQ (logbook hours — general info), Book. SIGNATURE 1: a little car follows the road as you scroll (getPointAtLength + tangent rotation); a traffic light at the top turns green on load; reduced motion: car parked at each stop. SIGNATURE 2: booking — choose package, pickup suburb, then a week availability grid (some slots taken) → summary → DemoKit toast. Full EN ⇄ 中文 toggle. Phone: road becomes a straight lane down the left edge with the car moving along it.

name: Clutch & Co. Driving

interaction.en: Shift gears to navigate, rev up with a road-rules quiz
interaction.zh: 换挡导航，答题让转速表飙升

brief: Manual-transmission specialist. The whole site is a dashboard. Palette: carbon #111418 (subtle carbon-fibre pattern), amber gauge light #FFB347, red line #E63946, cool white #E8EEF2. Fonts: Chakra Petch + Inter. LAYOUT (desktop): speedometer left, tachometer right, a centre display where content 'screens' appear; navigation is an H-pattern gear shifter — 1 About manual, 2 Packages (sample prices), 3 Quiz, 4 Instructors, 5 Book, R back; clicking a gear shifts screens with a needle sweep and a screen transition. SIGNATURE: road-rules warm-up quiz — 8 general, correct Australian questions (e.g. at a roundabout give way to vehicles already on it; default urban limit is 50 km/h unless signed; hazard-perception tips); each correct answer revs the tachometer and bumps the speedo; result screen with score and 'general information — check your state's handbook'. Phone: gauges shrink into a top strip, the screen becomes the page, gears become a bottom segmented control. Keyboard: number keys 1–5 shift gears.

name: Heavy Haul Training

interaction.en: Slide the weight, watch the truck morph
interaction.zh: 拖动载重，卡车实时变形

brief: Heavy-vehicle licence courses. Palette: hazard yellow #FFC400, black #121212, steel #8A9199, concrete #D9D6D0, safety orange #FF6A13; diagonal hazard stripes, riveted steel plates, stencil type. Fonts: Saira Stencil One + Barlow Condensed. LAYOUT: stencil plates grid for licence classes LR, MR, HR, HC, MC; course details (duration, what's included, assessment day); 'Is this for me?' checklist; illustrated fleet; enquiries. SIGNATURE: 'Which licence do I need?' — a GVM slider (tonnes), axle count toggle and trailer toggle; an SVG truck morphs smoothly between classes (LR van → MR rigid → HR 3-axle rigid → HC prime mover + semi-trailer → MC B-double) and the matching class plate lights up with a plain-English description (general info; check your state road authority). Phone: plates 2 columns, slider full width.

name: Throttle Up Rider Training

interaction.en: Hold to rev (with optional engine sound)
interaction.zh: 按住轰油门（可选引擎声）

brief: Motorcycle rider training. Punk zine: black #0D0D0D, safety orange #FF5F1F, off-white #F2F0EA, halftone dots, torn-paper edges (SVG), diagonal slashes, sticker labels. Fonts: Bebas Neue + Space Mono. LAYOUT: magazine-cover hero with a diagonal split and huge type; courses (pre-learner, pre-provisional, refresher, advanced cornering — sample prices); gear checklist; wet-weather policy; the crew (fictional, illustrated helmets); book. SIGNATURE: hold-to-rev — a big REV button (press & hold, or hold Space): a tachometer needle climbs, the page shakes very slightly (none in reduced motion), releasing drops revs; optional engine sound synthesised with Web Audio (sawtooth + filtered noise, off by default, clear sound toggle). Hitting the red line unlocks a 'sample' voucher code. Phone: REV button at thumb reach.

name: Easy Tiger Removals

interaction.en: Pack the truck to size your move
interaction.zh: 装满卡车估算搬家规模

brief: Friendly removalist. Every section is a cardboard box: kraft #C8A27A with corrugated edge, translucent tape #E8D9B0, black stencil stamps ('FRAGILE', 'THIS WAY UP'), red marker #C0392B handwriting. Fonts: Permanent Marker + Archivo. LAYOUT: staggered stack of boxes on desktop (flaps, tape, handwritten labels): services (house moves, office, piano, packing & boxes), how pricing works, moving-day checklist, Perth areas, get a quote. SIGNATURE: truck-fill estimator — drag furniture icons (sofa, bed, fridge, washing machine, 10 boxes, dining table, desk, bookshelf, TV) into an SVG truck's cargo grid; items snap into free cells; a fill % bar recommends truck size (4.5 t / 6 t / 10 t) and 'about N movers, N hours' (illustrative); 'Request this quote' → DemoKit toast. Keyboard/touch: each item has + / − buttons. Phone: list with steppers and the truck fill bar.

name: Mirror Finish Detailing

interaction.en: Drag from swirled paint to mirror gloss
interaction.zh: 拖动对比：划痕漆面变镜面

brief: Premium detailing. Palette: jet black #07080A, gunmetal #1C2127, electric teal #19E3D2, chrome #C9D1D9; reflections via layered linear-gradients, a light sweep across surfaces. Fonts: Michroma + Inter. LAYOUT: full-bleed hero with a stylised side-profile sedan (SVG) and an animated light sweep reflection; packages (wash & wax, interior deep clean, paint correction, ceramic coating — sample prices); process steps; mobile detailing zones; book. interaction.zh: 拨动开关点亮每个板块

interaction.zh: 重画睫毛与眉形

name: Allegro Piano Studio

interaction.zh: 弹钢琴（鼠标、触摸或键盘）

Fees (sample), VI. Enquire. name: Little Dippers Swim School

Phone: lanes stay horizontal but full width.

Code editor UI: editor #1E1E2E, sidebar #181825, syntax colours pink #F38BA8, green #A6E3A1, blue #89B4FA, yellow #F9E2AF; line numbers, tabs, status bar, minimap. Fonts: Source Code Pro + Inter. LAYOUT: file tree (about.md, experience.ts, projects/, skills.json, contact.sh), tabs, an editor pane with syntax-highlighted content (hand-built highlighting via spans), a status bar (branch, line/col). SIGNATURE: clicking files opens tabs; a command palette (Ctrl/⌘+K) jumps to files; 'Run ▶' on contact.sh 'executes' in a terminal panel with typed output (contact info = fictional); dark/light theme toggle. Phone: the tree becomes a top dropdown; editor full width with soft-wrapped lines.

name: Bec & The Van

interaction.en: Drag stickers anywhere; follow the van
interaction.zh: 随意拖贴纸；追踪房车路线

brief: Van-life creator's link-in-bio page (fictional person). Sticker-bomb collage: sunset orange #FF7B54, seafoam #4ECDC4, sunflower #FFD166, grape #7B2CBF, white die-cut stickers with drop shadows. Fonts: Luckiest Guy + Inter. LAYOUT: mobile-first single column of big link buttons (latest video, van tour, gear list, the route map, collabs & media kit, presets shop), with a small 'Where's the van?' mini map of the east coast showing the current stop; on desktop a phone-width column is centred with stickers scattered around. SIGNATURE: drag stickers (van, palm, sun, wave, 'hi!', camera, kangaroo road sign) anywhere — pointer + keyboard (focus + arrows); buttons wobble on hover; a 'tip jar' button (DemoKit toast). All outgoing links kit-intercepted.

name: Rise with Tara

interaction.en: Words move and grow as you scroll
interaction.zh: 文字随滚动生长变化

brief: Coach and speaker (fictional person). Kinetic typography on a sunrise: background gradient dawn navy #1B1F3B → magenta #D1495B → sun orange #F79256 → morning cream #FFF4E0 progressing as you scroll. Fonts: Recursive (variable: weight, slant, casual axes) + Inter. LAYOUT: a manifesto hero where lines animate in; coaching (1:1, group, workshops), speaking topics, how it works, free resources (demo), book a discovery call. SIGNATURE: scroll-driven kinetic type — each manifesto line's weight/slant/casual axes and scale are tied to its scroll progress (JS with rAF or CSS scroll timelines with fallback); values cards flip on click. Reduced motion: static, beautifully set type with the gradient.

name: RAWHEM

interaction.en: Leave a trail of garments with your cursor
interaction.zh: 光标拖出一串服装剪影

brief: Independent label. Avant-garde brutalism: white, black, safety red #FF2A1A; raw grid, oversized type bleeding off edges, mixed alignments, mono captions, overlapping blocks. Fonts: Dela Gothic One + Martian Mono. LAYOUT: a collage of flat garment silhouettes (SVG coats, trousers, dresses) and huge 'SS27' type; sections: collection (lookbook of 8 looks with look numbers), stockists (sample), the atelier, care, newsletter. SIGNATURE: cursor-trail lookbook — moving the pointer leaves a trail of garment cut-outs that fade; click to freeze a look into the grid; a size-guide modal with a measurement diagram; keyboard: 'Next look' / 'Freeze' buttons. Phone: tap to drop garments; all content remains readable.

name: Always & Ever Weddings

interaction.en: Break the wax seal; get your countdown plan
interaction.zh: 拆开火漆，获得倒计时计划

brief: Wedding planner in wine country. Romantic: ivory #FFFBF5, blush #F4D9D0, sage #A8B5A2, deep rose text #5E2B34, gold foil gradients #D8B76A; botanical line art. Fonts: Great Vibes (script accents only) + Libre Caslon Text. LAYOUT: hero is an envelope with a wax seal; click the seal (or Enter) → the flap opens (CSS 3D) and the invitation card slides up revealing the site; then planning packages (full, partial, on-the-day — sample prices), venues we love (fictional estates), our process, planning checklist, enquire. SIGNATURE 2: countdown planner — pick your wedding date → a countdown plus a generated timeline (12 months: venue; 9: photographer; 6: invitations; 3: final fittings; 1: seating plan; week-of tasks) with tickable items (session only). Provide 'Open' button and reduced-motion instant open. Phone: envelope scaled.

name: Wildflower & Wattle

interaction.en: Build a bouquet of native blooms
interaction.zh: 用澳洲原生花材搭一束花

brief: Florist specialising in Australian natives. Pressed flowers: cream #FAF6EE, eucalyptus #8FA89B, wattle yellow #E9B824, waratah red #C22A36, banksia orange #D98032, dusty pink #E8B4B8; pressed-petal textures in SVG. Fonts: Abhaya Libre + Work Sans. LAYOUT: bouquet at the centre of the hero; weekly bouquets, weddings & events, native arrangements, sympathy flowers, delivery zones, order. SIGNATURE: bouquet builder — tap flowers (waratah, banksia, kangaroo paw, eucalyptus, wattle, garden rose, lisianthus, gum nuts) to add stems; stems converge and arrange radially into a bouquet (SVG); choose wrap (kraft, linen, white) and size; price updates (sample); a card message with live handwritten preview; order → DemoKit toast.

name: Long Take Films

interaction.en: Scrub scenes and apply colour grades
interaction.zh: 拖动场景并套用调色

brief: Wedding & brand videographer. Cinematic: letterbox black bars, film grain, anamorphic lens flare streaks (CSS gradients), teal #2BB3B1 & orange #E8A15B grade; timecode HUD in monospace; safe-area guides. Fonts: Teko + Azeret Mono. LAYOUT: the page is a film player — sections are scenes with timecodes (00:00:12:05): Scene 1 Brand stories, Scene 2 Weddings, Scene 3 Packages (sample), Scene 4 Behind the scenes, Scene 5 Contact; a scrubber timeline at the bottom shows scene markers and jumps to them. The 'footage' is a generative animated scene (canvas parallax silhouettes: hills, sun, sea, a couple) behind the titles. SIGNATURE: colour-grade presets ('Warm film', 'Teal & orange', 'Black & white', 'Faded') apply CSS filter grades to the scene; play/pause. Reduced motion: a static frame.

name: Dog-Eared Books

interaction.en: Pull a book; blind-date a book
interaction.zh: 抽一本书；和书来场盲约

brief: Independent bookshop. Cosy library: wood #5B3A29, lamp glow #FFD8A8, deep green #1F3B2D, burgundy #6D1A36, cream pages #F6EEDC; book spines as CSS gradients with embossed fictional titles and authors. Fonts: Sorts Mill Goudy + Nunito Sans. LAYOUT: bookshelves as navigation; staff picks (fictional books with 'staff notes'), events (author talks — sample), book club, kids' corner, gift cards, visit. SIGNATURE 1: pull a book — click/Enter a spine and it slides out and turns to show its cover and a staff note; shelf is keyboard navigable. SIGNATURE 2: 'Blind date with a book' — brown-paper parcels with three hint words; unwrap animation reveals the fictional title; 'Reserve' → DemoKit toast.

name: Second Spin Vintage

interaction.en: Slide the clothing rack
interaction.zh: 拨动衣架

brief: Vintage clothing store. Mid-century mail-order catalogue: two-colour print — teal #1F7A7A and tomato #E4572E on newsprint cream #F3ECDC, black text; halftone illustrations, item numbers, order codes, dashed coupons. Fonts: Bowlby One SC + Karla. LAYOUT: catalogue pages with numbered items ('No. 4021 — Suede jacket, 1970s, size M'); sections: new in, by era, sizing guide, trade in your clothes, visit. SIGNATURE: a clothing rack — drag the rack horizontally with inertia (or arrow keys / buttons) to browse SVG garments on hangers that swing slightly; filters by size and era; clicking an item opens its catalogue entry with measurements; 'Hold it for me' → DemoKit toast. Phone: rack swipes horizontally with visible affordance.

name: Fern & Frond Nursery

interaction.en: Match plants to your light & lifestyle
interaction.zh: 按光照与生活方式匹配植物

brief: Plant nursery. Vintage botanical specimen plates: aged paper #F3EDDF, sage #8A9A7B, deep green #2F4A3A, sepia ink #4A3B2A; engraved-style SVG line illustrations of plants, specimen labels. Fonts: Petrona + Overpass. LAYOUT: a grid of specimen plates (Latin name in italics, common name, care symbols), sections: indoor, Australian natives, edibles & herbs, workshops, delivery. SIGNATURE: plant matcher — controls for light (low → bright), pet-safe only, care level, space (desk / floor / balcony); matching plates stay vivid while others fade and shrink; selecting a plant generates a care card with a watering schedule; note: check toxicity for pets (general).

name: Spoke & Chain Cycles

interaction.en: Explore parts; find your frame size
interaction.zh: 查看零件；计算车架尺寸

brief: Bike shop and workshop. Technical exploded view: graphite #1F2328, safety orange #FF6F00, light grey #EDEFF2, white; line drawings with numbered callouts and leader lines. Fonts: Exo 2 + Inter. LAYOUT: exploded bicycle hero (SVG parts separated: frame, fork, wheels, crankset, chain, derailleur, saddle, bars); servicing (sample prices), bike fit, new bikes (road, gravel, commuter, kids), e-bikes, commuter tips, visit. SIGNATURE: hover/tap/Tab a part to highlight it with specs and service tips; an 'Assemble' button animates the parts snapping together (and back); a bike-fit calculator — height + inseam → suggested frame size range (illustrative) for road / MTB / hybrid; book a service via service-level cards → DemoKit toast.

name: Kerb Crawlers Skate Co.

style.zh: 混凝土墙上的街头喷漆

interaction.en: Design and spin a 3D deck
interaction.zh: 设计并旋转 3D 滑板

brief: Skate shop. Street style: concrete grey texture #BDBDBD, black #111, spray neon green #39FF14, hot orange #FF5E13; spray drips, stencils, gaffer tape. Fonts: Rock Salt (spray headings) + Barlow. LAYOUT: a concrete wall with spray-painted headings; decks, wheels & trucks, complete setups, skate lessons, local spots (stylised map), shop. SIGNATURE: 3D deck designer — a skateboard deck in CSS 3D; drag to spin, arrow keys to rotate; choose shape (popsicle, cruiser, old-school), graphic (stencil pattern presets drawn in SVG), deck colour, grip tape style and wheel colour; live price (sample); 'Flip it' shows grip vs graphic side. Neon green on grey must meet contrast — use it on black.

name: Opaline Jewellery

interaction.en: Configure a ring with live shimmer
interaction.zh: 定制戒指，实时闪光

brief: Handmade jewellery. Light luxury: ivory silk #FBF8F2, pearl #EEE8DF, champagne #D9C3A0, soft black #1C1C1C; opal play-of-colour as slowly animated conic/radial gradients (subtle; static in reduced motion). Fonts: Cinzel + Montserrat. LAYOUT: single hero product close-up (SVG ring with shimmering stone); collections (rings, earrings, necklaces), custom design process, care guide, ring sizing guide, book an appointment. SIGNATURE: ring configurator — metal (yellow gold, rose gold, white gold, sterling silver), stone (Australian opal, sapphire, morganite, lab-grown diamond — generic), setting (solitaire, halo, bezel), band width; the SVG ring updates with the right metal gradients and stone shimmer; a sample price range updates; a ring size helper (circumference → size). Phone: ring sticky at the top while configuring.

name: Kiln & Clay Studio

interaction.en: Shape a pot on the wheel, then fire it
interaction.zh: 在拉坯机上塑形并烧制

brief: Ceramics studio with classes and a shop. Earthy: oat #F2EBE0, terracotta #B5643C, clay #D8B79A, charcoal glaze #2E2B28, celadon #A9C1B3; grainy paper texture, irregular blob-shaped sections, handmade feel. Fonts: Rozha One + Nunito Sans. LAYOUT: organic blobs — classes (wheel throwing, handbuilding, glazing), studio membership, shop (cups, bowls, vases — sample prices), firing services, visit. SIGNATURE: pottery wheel — drag control points on one side of the pot profile (or use sliders for belly / neck / lip width and height); a Canvas/SVG lathe renders the revolved pot with shading while the wheel spins; choose a glaze; 'Fire it' → kiln glow animation and the final glazed look (glossy highlight, speckles).

name: Wick & Wander Candles

interaction.en: Light the wick; light follows you
interaction.zh: 点燃烛芯；光随你移动

brief: Small-batch candle maker. Dark and moody: near-black #120E0B, warm amber #FFB45E glow, wax cream #F3E3C3, smoky plum #3A2A33. Fonts: Prata + Quattrocento Sans. LAYOUT: the page is dark; a radial candlelight glow follows the pointer (on touch it centres on the section in view) with gentle flicker, warming nearby content — but ALL text stays readable outside the light (≥4.5:1). Sections: collections (Eucalypt & Rain, Fireside Tea, Salt & Fig, Wattle Bloom), pour-your-own workshops, ingredients (soy wax, cotton wick — the fictional brand's choices), stockists (sample), shop. SIGNATURE: light the wick — click the unlit candle (or Enter): a canvas flame ignites and flickers, the page warms; a scent picker tints the flame glow and swaps the scent notes. Reduced motion: steady glow, no flicker.

name: Bittersweet Chocolatier

interaction.en: Fill a box, bite to see the filling
interaction.zh: 装满礼盒，咬一口看夹心

brief: Hills chocolatier. Glossy chocolate: dark cocoa #2B1710, milk #7B4B2A, gold foil #C9A227, ruby #B0304A, cream #F5E9DA; glossy highlights with gradients, foil textures. Fonts: Yeseva One + Mulish. LAYOUT: the structure is a chocolate box — a grid of compartments holding the sections: signature collection, build a box, hot chocolate, workshops, corporate gifts, visit. SIGNATURE: build a box — drag chocolates (salted caramel, raspberry ruby, hazelnut praline, lemon myrtle ganache, sea-salt dark, wattleseed truffle) into a 9-slot box (or tap 'Add'); hover/focus shows a 'bite' cross-section revealing the filling; box price updates (sample); choose a ribbon colour; 'Wrap it' animation → DemoKit toast.

name: Good Boy Supplies

interaction.en: Pick your hero pet, get a box
interaction.zh: 选择你的宠物主角，定制礼盒

brief: Pet food & treats subscription. Comic book: panels with thick black gutters, Ben-Day halftone dots, CMYK brights — cyan #00AEEF, magenta #EC008C, yellow #FFF200 — speech bubbles and action bursts ('WOOF!'). Fonts: Bangers + Comic Neue. LAYOUT: a comic page — panel 1 hero 'Meet Biscuit', panels for products (treats, food, toys), how the subscription works (a 3-panel strip), plans (sample prices), FAQ; panels pop in on scroll (reduced motion: static). SIGNATURE: 'Choose your hero' — pick dog or cat, size, age and allergies → a panel draws your pet in comic style (SVG variations) and suggests a monthly box with items; frequency toggle; 'Subscribe' → DemoKit toast (no payment).

name: Wren Cottage B&B

interaction.en: Peek through the windows; pick your nights
interaction.zh: 透过窗户看房间；选择入住日期

brief: Three-room B&B in the high country. Storybook: evening blue #2E3A59, warm window glow #FFD27F, stone #C9C0B3, ivy green #5E7D4E, cream #FBF4E6; a painterly illustrated cottage (SVG with soft gradients) at dusk, fireflies drifting (off in reduced motion). Fonts: Merriweather + Source Sans 3. LAYOUT: the cottage hero; each lit window is a button → peeks into a room (The Wren Room, The Garden Suite, The Loft) with an illustrated interior and details (bed, view, bathroom); then breakfast menu, things to do nearby (general), policies, book. SIGNATURE: availability calendar with nightly sample rates, 2-night minimum on weekends, some nights unavailable; select check-in → check-out range (click, keyboard arrows + Enter) → summary with total → DemoKit toast.

name: Red Dust Expeditions

interaction.en: Drive the route day by day
interaction.zh: 逐日驾驶路线

brief: Small-group 4WD tours of the Red Centre. Palette: ochre red #B7472A, sand #E9C79A, dusk purple #4B3B5C, spinifex green #9CA36A, off-white #F6EDE1; topographic contour lines (SVG), dust grain. Fonts: Alumni Sans + Open Sans. Do not depict or name sacred sites as decoration and do not imitate Aboriginal art; landscapes are generic gorges, dunes, ranges and night sky; include a brief, respectful line that tours travel on the lands of Traditional Owners and follow park rules. LAYOUT: map-led — a large topographic map with a dotted route; tours (1-day, 3-day, 5-day — sample prices), what's included, what to bring, book. SIGNATURE: Day 1…Day 5 buttons animate a 4WD icon along the route with an odometer counting kilometres; each stop shows camp, distance, highlights (gorge walk, dune sunset, star-gazing). Phone: map full width, itinerary cards below.

name: Coral Coast Dive Co.

interaction.en: Descend by depth; find your dive
interaction.zh: 按深度下潜；找到适合的潜水

brief: Reef dive and snorkel trips. Underwater descent: background shifts from surface turquoise #3ED6E0 through #0B6E99 to deep navy #041C32 as you scroll; light rays from above, drifting particles, marine-life silhouettes (SVG/canvas: reef fish, turtle, manta, reef shark — gentle). Fonts: Kanit + Inter. LAYOUT: a side depth gauge (0–30 m) updates with scroll; content stations at depths: 0 m snorkel tours, 5 m intro dives, 12 m certified dives, 18 m advanced course, 30 m night dive (general info), then boat schedule (sample), what's included, book. SIGNATURE: 'Choose your dive' finder (experience level, days, snorkel or dive) highlights the matching station and animates a diver descending to it. Reduced motion: static colour bands per section.

name: Southern Sky Glamping

interaction.en: Connect the Southern Cross
interaction.zh: 连出南十字星

brief: Eco glamping retreat. Night sky: deep navy #0B1026, indigo #1B2350, starlight #F7F3E3, campfire orange #FF8C42, eucalyptus silhouettes; a canvas starfield with subtle twinkle. Fonts: Philosopher + Lato. LAYOUT: night landscape hero with glowing tents; a day/night toggle switches the whole site palette (day: warm sand and eucalyptus greens); tents (bell tent, safari suite, stargazer dome), what's included, experiences (bushwalks, stargazing), getting here, book. SIGNATURE: constellation game — click the stars of Crux (the Southern Cross) and the Pointers (Alpha and Beta Centauri) in order; lines draw between them; then an explanation of using the Southern Cross to find south (general astronomy). Stars are real buttons in a logical order for keyboard users.

name: Snowgum Lodge

style.zh: 复古滑雪海报与翻牌显示屏

interaction.en: Flip the lifts & snow board
interaction.zh: 翻牌显示缆车与雪况

brief: Alpine lodge. 1950s travel/ski poster: alpine blue #1F4E79, snow white #F7FBFF, cherry red #D7263D, pine green #2E5E4E, butter #F2D492; flat bold mountain shapes and skier silhouettes; gentle snowfall canvas (off in reduced motion). Fonts: Fjalla One + Cabin. LAYOUT: poster hero; rooms & bunks, lodge life (drying room, fondue night), season dates (sample), getting here (general: carry chains when required), book. SIGNATURE: a split-flap departure board 'Lifts & runs today' — rows flip letter by letter (animated split-flap characters) to show lifts OPEN / ON HOLD / CLOSED, snow depth, temperature, wind (clearly 'sample data'); an 'Update board' button re-flips with new values; the board is also readable as a plain table for screen readers.

name: Salt & Sail Boat Hire

interaction.en: Spell your name in signal flags
interaction.zh: 用信号旗拼出你的名字

brief: Boat hire on sheltered waterways. Nautical: navy #0A2342, white, signal red #D62828, yellow #FCBF49, sky blue #2A9DF4; rope borders, knots, a halyard line. Fonts: Staatliches + Hind. LAYOUT: a marina grid of boat cards (runabout, pontoon party boat, small sailing yacht, kayaks) with specs (people, fuel, sample half/full-day prices), what's included, safety briefing, weather policy, licence requirements (general: 'requirements vary — we'll check with you'), book. SIGNATURE: signal-flag translator — type a name or boat name → it's spelled with correct International Code of Signals flags A–Z (accurate SVG designs) hoisted on a halyard with a gentle wave (static in reduced motion); plus booking: date, half/full day, boat → DemoKit toast.

name: Wattle Park Wanderers FC

interaction.en: Sort the ladder, flip the scoreboard
interaction.zh: 排序积分榜，翻转记分牌

brief: Community soccer club (juniors to masters). Club colours green #1E6B3A and gold #F2C12E; an old wooden scoreboard #5B4A3A with white painted numerals; chalk pitch lines. Fonts: Graduate + Roboto Condensed. LAYOUT: scoreboard hero (Wanderers vs opponent, last result — sample), fixtures & results, the ladder table, teams (U8–U17, women's, men's, masters), training times, registration (sample fees), sponsors (honest placeholder: 'Your business here — become a sponsor'), club news. SIGNATURE: ladder you can sort (points, goal difference, form) and filter by division; clicking a team shows its W/D/L form chips and next fixture; switching games on the scoreboard flips the numerals. Phone: the table scrolls horizontally inside its own container with a visible affordance; the page itself never scrolls sideways.

name: Riverside Night Market

interaction.en: Plan your night on the stall map
interaction.zh: 在摊位地图上规划路线

brief: Weekly riverside night market. Lantern-lit: dusk navy #101935, lantern red #E63946, warm gold #F4A261, string-light yellow #FFE66D, teal #2A9D8F; glowing SVG lanterns that sway, bokeh. Fonts: Titan One + DM Sans. LAYOUT: hero with swinging lanterns and 'Every Friday'; an interactive stall map (a stylised riverside park plan) with ~24 stalls (dumplings, gözleme, arepas, satay, mango sticky rice, churros, handmade jewellery, plants, candles, a live-music stage); this week, music line-up (sample), getting there, become a stallholder (demo form). SIGNATURE: map filters (Food, Makers, Music, Vegan) make pins glow; tap a stall for what they sell and where; 'Plan my night' adds stalls to a list and draws a walking path between them in order. Reduced motion: lanterns still.

name: Second Chance Animal Rescue

interaction.en: Find a match; see what a donation provides
interaction.zh: 匹配宠物；看看捐款能带来什么

brief: Volunteer-run animal rescue (fictional; do not claim charity registration or tax-deductibility). Warm hand-painted: paper #FFF8EE, gouache textures via SVG filters, warm orange #F28C38, soft teal #5BA8A0, brown #5C3D2E, pink #F6A6B2. Fonts: Amatic SC (large headings only) + Mulish. LAYOUT: adoptable animals as cards with hand-painted SVG portraits (names, age, personality), foster program, volunteer, donate, events. SIGNATURE 1: adoption match — filter by species, size, energy, good with kids/cats; cards shuffle with animation; 'Meet me' opens a profile with personality sliders. SIGNATURE 2: donation impact slider ($10–$500) → shows what that could provide (illustrative: a week of kitten food, a vaccination, a vet check) with icons filling in; 'Donate' → DemoKit toast (no payment).
